item.title: From Azure Functions to AWS Lambda: A .NET Developer’s Migration Playbook
item.description: Introduction Serverless has become the default for event-driven .NET workloads, and many teams that started on Azure Functions are now consolidating onto AWS to unify their compute, data, and AI in single cloud. If you run C#/.NET serverless functions on Azure and want to move to AWS Lambda, this playbook gives you an end-to-end, repeatable […] Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/dotnet/from-azure-functions-to-aws-lambda-a-net-developers-migration-playbook/
